data.long_meaning: Athansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atman’ meaning ‘self’ and ‘Shri’ meaning ‘goddess of wealth’. The name Athansh signifies God's treasure, symbolizing wealth in the form of wisdom and knowledge. This name is believed to be a blessing from the gods for a prosperous and enlightened life. The name Athansh carries the meaning “God's Treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Athansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
